title: Puttering Pleatfin
statement: A palm-sized cuttlefish with apricot frills putters through blue-green water, rearranging white pebbles beneath a ceramic arch while little checkerboards ripple across its skin. Its tank is a quiet garden of ribbon grass and slanting amber light; each time it completes a perfect pebble circle, it nudges one stone out of place and hovers over the new possibility.
